items.title: Mrs. P. Thomas Agnes Brown Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: you have Max Hart, Henry Ragus, Dominic James LaRocca, Lawrence Shields, Anthony Sbarro, and Edwin B. Edwards.

ctx.x: Thank you very much, Miss Brown. Uh, let's see. In the District Court of the United States for the Northern District of Illinois' Eastern Division, you have Max Hart, Henry Ragus, Dominic James LaRocca, Lawrence Shields, Anthony Sbarro, and Edwin B. Edwards. Sbarro is spelled.
